name: FFS_IMPORT_QUEUE
description: Used to store state and log of asynchronous import processes.

columns.name: IMPORT_ID
columns.description: Async import unique identifier of the import process.

columns.name: USER_ID
columns.description: Async import refrence to user who made import. Reference to ffs_user.user_id.

columns.name: SESSION_ID
columns.description: Async import reference to session identifier.

columns.name: TYPE
columns.description: Async import type of imported data.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Async import status of import process.

columns.name: INFO
columns.description: Async import additional information for imported data.

columns.name: MAP
columns.description: Async import custom map to manage related data.

columns.name: SOURCE
columns.description: Async import information about souce of imported data.

columns.name: LOG
columns.description: Async import list of errors/warnings during import.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
